Ellipsoidal coordinates ​

See also

Theory: Spheroidal coordinates · Curvilinear differential calculus

Manual: Coordinate systems (symbolic) · Charts and coordinate conversions

Tutorials: The spheroid in spheroidal coordinates · Ellipsoidal coordinates

The ellipsoidal coordinates are the orthogonal system whose coordinate surfaces are the quadrics confocal with a triaxial ellipsoid: the ellipsoid itself is one of them, as the spheroid is in Spheroidal coordinates. This page derives the chart, its Lamé coefficients and its unit vectors from a single rational function, then writes the differential operators and the inversion of the chart. The coordinates and the semi-focal distances are those of Dassios (2012).

The chart itself is singular in both limits, a factor of taking the form : a spheroid is handled by its own system. Far from the foci, tends to the radius and the ellipsoids to spheres.
